rawContent: .@cheffernan_LIDC frames the discussion by @LIDC_UK, @NatureFoodJnl’s #expert panel on the future of #food, especially the impact of #ClimateChange https://t.co/dujIaJyBPv

#Alan Dangour’s team @LSHTM looks at how #climate change affects #FutureofFood. It looks bleak, especially for #vegetables, legumes.  #UK imports far more food than 50 years ago, mainly from developing countries whose need is greater. Unsustainable!
